## **Fixed ScannerScreen.js** (Fix overlapping elements)

```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import {
    View,
    StyleSheet,
    SafeAreaView,
    Alert,
    TouchableOpacity,
    Dimensions,
    Animated,
    StatusBar,
    Platform,
} from 'react-native';
import { Text, ActivityIndicator } from 'react-native-paper';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { LinearGradient } from 'expo-linear-gradient';
import { Camera, CameraType } from 'expo-camera';
import { BarCodeScanner } from 'expo-barcode-scanner';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { recordScan } from '../services/database';
import { useOffline } from '../context/OfflineContext';

const { width, height } = Dimensions.get('window');

// Item categories with your consistent colors
const ITEM_CATEGORIES = {
    'glass-bottles': { name: 'Glass Bottles', icon: 'wine', points: 10, color: '#059669' },
    'plastic-bottles': { name: 'Plastic Bottles', icon: 'water', points: 8, color: '#3b82f6' },
    'aluminum-cans': { name: 'Aluminum Cans', icon: 'cafe', points: 12, color: '#f59e0b' },
    'paper': { name: 'Paper', icon: 'document', points: 5, color: '#8b5cf6' },
    'cardboard': { name: 'Cardboard', icon: 'albums', points: 6, color: '#8b5cf6' },
    'electronic': { name: 'Electronics', icon: 'phone-portrait', points: 25, color: '#ef4444' },
    'organic': { name: 'Organic Waste', icon: 'leaf', points: 15, color: '#22c55e' },
};

export default function ScannerScreen({ navigation }) {
    const { user } = useAuth();
    const { queueOfflineAction } = useOffline();
    
    const [hasPermission, setHasPermission] = useState(null);
    const [scanned, setScanned] = useState(false);
    const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);
    const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState('glass-bottles');
    const [showCategorySelector, setShowCategorySelector] = useState(false);
    const [scanMode, setScanMode] = useState('auto'); // 'auto' or 'manual'
    
    // Animations
    const fadeAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
    const slideUpAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(100)).current;
    const scanLineAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
    const pulseAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(1)).current;
    const glowAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;

    useEffect(() => {
        getCameraPermissions();
        
        // Entrance animations
        Animated.parallel([
            Animated.timing(fadeAnim, {
                toValue: 1,
                duration: 600,
                useNativeDriver: true,
            }),
            Animated.timing(slideUpAnim, {
                toValue: 0,
                duration: 800,
                useNativeDriver: true,
            }),
        ]).start();

        // Scanning line animation
        Animated.loop(
            Animated.sequence([
                Animated.timing(scanLineAnim, {
                    toValue: 1,
                    duration: 2000,
                    useNativeDriver: true,
                }),
                Animated.timing(scanLineAnim, {
                    toValue: 0,
                    duration: 100,
                    useNativeDriver: true,
                }),
            ])
        ).start();

        // Pulse animation for buttons
        Animated.loop(
            Animated.sequence([
                Animated.timing(pulseAnim, {
                    toValue: 1.05,
                    duration: 1500,
                    useNativeDriver: true,
                }),
                Animated.timing(pulseAnim, {
                    toValue: 1,
                    duration: 1500,
                    useNativeDriver: true,
                }),
            ])
        ).start();

        // Glow effect
        Animated.loop(
            Animated.sequence([
                Animated.timing(glowAnim, {
                    toValue: 1,
                    duration: 2000,
                    useNativeDriver: true,
                }),
                Animated.timing(glowAnim, {
                    toValue: 0,
                    duration: 2000,
                    useNativeDriver: true,
                }),
            ])
        ).start();
    }, []);

    const getCameraPermissions = async () => {
        const { status } = await Camera.requestCameraPermissionsAsync();
        setHasPermission(status === 'granted');
    };

    const scanLineTransform = scanLineAnim.interpolate({
        inputRange: [0, 1],
        outputRange: [0, 200], // Scan line movement
    });

    const glowOpacity = glowAnim.interpolate({
        inputRange: [0, 1],
        outputRange: [0.3, 0.7],
    });

    const handleBarCodeScanned = ({ type, data }) => {
        if (scanned) return;
        
        setScanned(true);
        processScan(data);
    };

    const processScan = async (scannedData) => {
        try {
            setIsProcessing(true);
            
            // Simulate processing delay for better UX
            await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 500));
            
            const category = ITEM_CATEGORIES[selectedCategory];
            const scanData = {
                userId: user.uid,
                itemType: selectedCategory,
                points: category.points,
                timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
                scannedCode: scannedData,
            };

            const result = await recordScan(scanData);

            if (result.success) {
                showSuccessAnimation();
                Alert.alert(
                    'Success! 🎉', 
                    `+${category.points} points for ${category.name}!`,
                    [{ text: 'Continue Scanning', onPress: resetScanner }]
                );
            } else {
                if (result.offline) {
                    queueOfflineAction('scan', scanData);
                    Alert.alert(
                        'Queued for Sync 📱', 
                        'Scan saved offline and will sync when connected',
                        [{ text: 'Continue', onPress: resetScanner }]
                    );
                } else {
                    Alert.alert('Error', result.error || 'Failed to record scan');
                    resetScanner();
                }
            }
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Scan processing error:', error);
            Alert.alert('Error', 'Failed to process scan');
            resetScanner();
        } finally {
            setIsProcessing(false);
        }
    };

    const showSuccessAnimation = () => {
        // Add success animation logic here
        Animated.sequence([
            Animated.timing(pulseAnim, {
                toValue: 1.3,
                duration: 200,
                useNativeDriver: true,
            }),
            Animated.timing(pulseAnim, {
                toValue: 1,
                duration: 300,
                useNativeDriver: true,
            }),
        ]).start();
    };

    const resetScanner = () => {
        setScanned(false);
        setIsProcessing(false);
    };

    const manualScan = () => {
        if (isProcessing) return;
        
        const category = ITEM_CATEGORIES[selectedCategory];
        Alert.alert(
            `Scan ${category.name}?`,
            `This will add ${category.points} points to your account.`,
            [
                { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },
                { text: 'Confirm Scan', onPress: () => processScan('manual-scan') },
            ]
        );
    };

    const toggleCategorySelector = () => {
        setShowCategorySelector(!showCategorySelector);
    };

    const selectCategory = (categoryKey) => {
        setSelectedCategory(categoryKey);
        setShowCategorySelector(false);
        resetScanner();
    };

    if (hasPermission === null) {
        return (
            <SafeAreaView style={styles.loadingContainer}>
                <LinearGradient colors={['#059669', '#047857']} style={styles.gradient}>
                    <ActivityIndicator size="large" color="white" />
                    <Text style={styles.loadingText}>Requesting camera permission...</Text>
                </LinearGradient>
            </SafeAreaView>
        );
    }

    if (hasPermission === false) {
        return (
            <SafeAreaView style={styles.permissionContainer}>
                <LinearGradient colors={['#ef4444', '#dc2626']} style={styles.gradient}>
                    <View style={styles.permissionContent}>
                        <Ionicons name="camera-off" size={64} color="white" />
                        <Text style={styles.permissionTitle}>Camera Permission Required</Text>
                        <Text style={styles.permissionText}>
                            Please enable camera access to scan recyclable items and earn points.
                        </Text>
                        <TouchableOpacity style={styles.permissionButton} onPress={getCameraPermissions} activeOpacity={0.8}>
                            <LinearGradient
                                colors={['rgba(255,255,255,0.3)', 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)']}
                                style={styles.permissionButtonGradient}
                            >
                                <Text style={styles.permissionButtonText}>Enable Camera</Text>
                            </LinearGradient>
                        </TouchableOpacity>
                    </View>
                </LinearGradient>
            </SafeAreaView>
        );
    }

    const currentCategory = ITEM_CATEGORIES[selectedCategory];

    return (
        <SafeAreaView style={styles.container}>
            <StatusBar barStyle="light-content" backgroundColor="#059669" />
            
            {/* FIXED: Camera container with proper positioning */}
            <View style={styles.cameraContainer}>
                <Camera
                    style={styles.camera}
                    type={CameraType.back}
                    onBarCodeScanned={scanned ? undefined : handleBarCodeScanned}
                    barCodeScannerSettings={{
                        barCodeTypes: [BarCodeScanner.Constants.BarCodeType.qr, BarCodeScanner.Constants.BarCodeType.ean13],
                    }}
                />

                {/* FIXED: Overlay with proper z-index and positioning */}
                <View style={styles.overlay}>
                    {/* FIXED: Top section with proper spacing */}
                    <Animated.View 
                        style={[
                            styles.topSection,
                            { 
                                opacity: fadeAnim,
                                transform: [{ translateY: slideUpAnim.interpolate({
                                    inputRange: [0, 100],
                                    outputRange: [0, -50]
                                }) }]
                            }
                        ]}
                    >
                        <LinearGradient colors={['#059669', '#047857']} style={styles.headerCard}>
                            <TouchableOpacity
                                style={styles.backButton}
                                onPress={() => navigation.goBack()}
                                activeOpacity={0.7}
                            >
                                <Ionicons name="arrow-back" size={20} color="white" />
                                <Text style={styles.backButtonText}>Change</Text>
                            </TouchableOpacity>

                            <View style={styles.categoryInfo}>
                                <Ionicons name={currentCategory.icon} size={24} color="white" />
                                <Text style={styles.categoryName}>{currentCategory.name}</Text>
                                <View style={styles.pointsBadge}>
                                    <Ionicons name="star" size={16} color="white" />
                                    <Text style={styles.pointsText}>+{currentCategory.points}</Text>
                                </View>
                            </View>
                        </LinearGradient>
                    </Animated.View>

                    {/* FIXED: Instruction card with proper positioning */}
                    <Animated.View 
                        style={[
                            styles.instructionContainer,
                            { 
                                opacity: fadeAnim,
                                transform: [{ scale: pulseAnim }]
                            }
                        ]}
                    >
                        <LinearGradient colors={['rgba(5, 150, 105, 0.9)', 'rgba(4, 120, 87, 0.9)']} style={styles.instructionCard}>
                            <Text style={styles.instructionText}>Point at barcode or QR code</Text>
                        </LinearGradient>
                    </Animated.View>

                    {/* FIXED: Scanning frame with proper center positioning */}
                    <View style={styles.scanningArea}>
                        <View style={styles.scanFrame}>
                            {/* Corner brackets */}
                            <View style={[styles.corner, styles.topLeft]} />
                            <View style={[styles.corner, styles.topRight]} />
                            <View style={[styles.corner, styles.bottomLeft]} />
                            <View style={[styles.corner, styles.bottomRight]} />
                            
                            {/* Animated scanning line */}
                            <Animated.View
                                style={[
                                    styles.scanLine,
                                    {
                                        transform: [{ translateY: scanLineTransform }],
                                        opacity: glowOpacity,
                                    },
                                ]}
                            />
                        </View>
                    </View>

                    {/* FIXED: Bottom section with proper spacing and positioning */}
                    <Animated.View 
                        style={[
                            styles.bottomSection,
                            { 
                                opacity: fadeAnim,
                                transform: [{ translateY: slideUpAnim }]
                            }
                        ]}
                    >
                        {/* Info text */}
                        <View style={styles.infoContainer}>
                            <Ionicons name="bulb" size={16} color="#fbbf24" />
                            <Text style={styles.infoText}>Works with any barcode or QR code</Text>
                        </View>

                        {/* FIXED: Action buttons with proper spacing */}
                        <View style={styles.actionButtonsContainer}>
                            {/* Manual scan button */}
                            <TouchableOpacity
                                style={styles.manualScanButton}
                                onPress={manualScan}
                                disabled={isProcessing}
                                activeOpacity={0.8}
                            >
                                <LinearGradient colors={['#059669', '#047857']} style={styles.manualScanGradient}>
                                    {isProcessing ? (
                                        <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="white" />
                                    ) : (
                                        <Text style={styles.manualScanText}>
                                            Scanning: {currentCategory.name}
                                        </Text>
                                    )}
                                </LinearGradient>
                            </TouchableOpacity>

                            {/* Category selector button */}
                            <TouchableOpacity
                                style={styles.categorySelectorButton}
                                onPress={toggleCategorySelector}
                                activeOpacity={0.7}
                            >
                                <LinearGradient
                                    colors={['rgba(0,0,0,0.7)', 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)']}
                                    style={styles.categorySelectorGradient}
                                >
                                    <Ionicons name="close" size={24} color="white" />
                                </LinearGradient>
                            </TouchableOpacity>
                        </View>
                    </Animated.View>

                    {/* FIXED: Category selector with proper positioning */}
                    {showCategorySelector && (
                        <Animated.View 
                            style={[
                                styles.categorySelector,
                                { 
                                    opacity: fadeAnim,
                                    transform: [{ translateY: slideUpAnim }]
                                }
                            ]}
                        >
                            <LinearGradient colors={['#ffffff', '#f9fafb']} style={styles.categorySelectorContent}>
                                <View style={styles.categorySelectorHeader}>
                                    <Text style={styles.categorySelectorTitle}>Select Item Type</Text>
                                    <TouchableOpacity onPress={toggleCategorySelector} style={styles.closeButton}>
                                        <Ionicons name="close" size={24} color="#6b7280" />
                                    </TouchableOpacity>
                                </View>

                                <View style={styles.categoriesGrid}>
                                    {Object.entries(ITEM_CATEGORIES).map(([key, category]) => (
                                        <TouchableOpacity
                                            key={key}
                                            style={[
                                                styles.categoryItem,
                                                selectedCategory === key && styles.categoryItemSelected,
                                                { borderColor: category.color }
                                            ]}
                                            onPress={() => selectCategory(key)}
                                            activeOpacity={0.7}
                                        >
                                            <LinearGradient
                                                colors={
                                                    selectedCategory === key 
                                                        ? [category.color, `${category.color}dd`]
                                                        : ['#ffffff', '#f9fafb']
                                                }
                                                style={styles.categoryItemGradient}
                                            >
                                                <Ionicons 
                                                    name={category.icon} 
                                                    size={24} 
                                                    color={selectedCategory === key ? 'white' : category.color} 
                                                />
                                                <Text style={[
                                                    styles.categoryItemName,
                                                    { color: selectedCategory === key ? 'white' : '#1f2937' }
                                                ]}>
                                                    {category.name}
                                                </Text>
                                                <View style={[
                                                    styles.categoryPoints,
                                                    { backgroundColor: selectedCategory === key ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)' : category.color }
                                                ]}>
                                                    <Text style={[
                                                        styles.categoryPointsText,
                                                        { color: selectedCategory === key ? 'white' : 'white' }
                                                    ]}>
                                                        +{category.points}
                                                    </Text>
                                                </View>
                                            </LinearGradient>
                                        </TouchableOpacity>
                                    ))}
                                </View>
                            </LinearGradient>
                        </Animated.View>
                    )}

                    {/* Processing overlay */}
                    {isProcessing && (
                        <View style={styles.processingOverlay}>
                            <LinearGradient colors={['rgba(5, 150, 105, 0.95)', 'rgba(4, 120, 87, 0.95)']} style={styles.processingContent}>
                                <Animated.View style={{ transform: [{ scale: pulseAnim }] }}>
                                    <ActivityIndicator size="large" color="white" />
                                </Animated.View>
                                <Text style={styles.processingText}>Processing scan...</Text>
                                ```
                                <Text style={styles.processingSubtext}>Calculating eco-points</Text>
                                ```
                            </LinearGradient>
                        </View>
                    )}
                </View>
            </View>
        </SafeAreaView>
    );
}
```

## **Fix 2: Updated ScannerScreen.js** (Without ExpoBarCodeScanner dependency)

```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import {
    View,
    StyleSheet,
    SafeAreaView,
    Alert,
    TouchableOpacity,
    Dimensions,
    Animated,
    StatusBar,
    Platform,
} from 'react-native';
import { Text, ActivityIndicator } from 'react-native-paper';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { LinearGradient } from 'expo-linear-gradient';
import { Camera, CameraType } from 'expo-camera';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { recordScan } from '../services/database';
import { useOffline } from '../context/OfflineContext';

const { width, height } = Dimensions.get('window');

// Item categories with your consistent colors
const ITEM_CATEGORIES = {
    'glass-bottles': { name: 'Glass Bottles', icon: 'wine', points: 10, color: '#059669' },
    'plastic-bottles': { name: 'Plastic Bottles', icon: 'water', points: 8, color: '#3b82f6' },
    'aluminum-cans': { name: 'Aluminum Cans', icon: 'cafe', points: 12, color: '#f59e0b' },
    'paper': { name: 'Paper', icon: 'document', points: 5, color: '#8b5cf6' },
    'cardboard': { name: 'Cardboard', icon: 'albums', points: 6, color: '#8b5cf6' },
    'electronic': { name: 'Electronics', icon: 'phone-portrait', points: 25, color: '#ef4444' },
    'organic': { name: 'Organic Waste', icon: 'leaf', points: 15, color: '#22c55e' },
};

export default function ScannerScreen({ navigation }) {
    const { user } = useAuth();
    const { queueOfflineAction } = useOffline();
    
    const [hasPermission, setHasPermission] = useState(null);
    const [scanned, setScanned] = useState(false);
    const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);
    const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState('glass-bottles');
    const [showCategorySelector, setShowCategorySelector] = useState(false);
    
    // Animations
    const fadeAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
    const slideUpAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(100)).current;
    const scanLineAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
    const pulseAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(1)).current;
    const glowAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;

    useEffect(() => {
        getCameraPermissions();
        
        // Entrance animations
        Animated.parallel([
            Animated.timing(fadeAnim, {
                toValue: 1,
                duration: 600,
                useNativeDriver: true,
            }),
            Animated.timing(slideUpAnim, {
                toValue: 0,
                duration: 800,
                useNativeDriver: true,
            }),
        ]).start();

        // Scanning line animation
        Animated.loop(
            Animated.sequence([
                Animated.timing(scanLineAnim, {
                    toValue: 1,
                    duration: 2000,
                    useNativeDriver: true,
                }),
                Animated.timing(scanLineAnim, {
                    toValue: 0,
                    duration: 100,
                    useNativeDriver: true,
                }),
            ])
        ).start();

        // Pulse animation
        Animated.loop(
            Animated.sequence([
                Animated.timing(pulseAnim, {
                    toValue: 1.05,
                    duration: 1500,
                    useNativeDriver: true,
                }),
                Animated.timing(pulseAnim, {
                    toValue: 1,
                    duration: 1500,
                    useNativeDriver: true,
                }),
            ])
        ).start();

        // Glow effect
        Animated.loop(
            Animated.sequence([
                Animated.timing(glowAnim, {
                    toValue: 1,
                    duration: 2000,
                    useNativeDriver: true,
                }),
                Animated.timing(glowAnim, {
                    toValue: 0,
                    duration: 2000,
                    useNativeDriver: true,
                }),
            ])
        ).start();
    }, []);

    const getCameraPermissions = async () => {
        const { status } = await Camera.requestCameraPermissionsAsync();
        setHasPermission(status === 'granted');
    };

    const scanLineTransform = scanLineAnim.interpolate({
        inputRange: [0, 1],
        outputRange: [0, 200],
    });

    const glowOpacity = glowAnim.interpolate({
        inputRange: [0, 1],
        outputRange: [0.3, 0.7],
    });

    // FIXED: Handle barcode scanning with Camera component's onBarCodeScanned
    const handleBarCodeScanned = ({ type, data }) => {
        if (scanned) return;
        
        setScanned(true);
        processScan(data);
    };

    const processScan = async (scannedData) => {
        try {
            setIsProcessing(true);
            
            // Simulate processing delay
            await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 500));
            
            const category = ITEM_CATEGORIES[selectedCategory];
            const scanData = {
                userId: user.uid,
                itemType: selectedCategory,
                points: category.points,
                timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
                scannedCode: scannedData,
            };

            const result = await recordScan(scanData);

            if (result.success) {
                showSuccessAnimation();
                Alert.alert(
                    'Success! 🎉', 
                    `+${category.points} points for ${category.name}!`,
                    [{ text: 'Continue Scanning', onPress: resetScanner }]
                );
            } else {
                if (result.offline) {
                    queueOfflineAction('scan', scanData);
                    Alert.alert(
                        'Queued for Sync 📱', 
                        'Scan saved offline and will sync when connected',
                        [{ text: 'Continue', onPress: resetScanner }]
                    );
                } else {
                    Alert.alert('Error', result.error || 'Failed to record scan');
                    resetScanner();
                }
            }
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Scan processing error:', error);
            Alert.alert('Error', 'Failed to process scan');
            resetScanner();
        } finally {
            setIsProcessing(false);
        }
    };

    const showSuccessAnimation = () => {
        Animated.sequence([
            Animated.timing(pulseAnim, {
                toValue: 1.2,
                duration: 200,
                useNativeDriver: true,
            }),
            Animated.timing(pulseAnim, {
                toValue: 1,
                duration: 300,
                useNativeDriver: true,
            }),
        ]).start();
    };

    const resetScanner = () => {
        setScanned(false);
        setIsProcessing(false);
    };

    const manualScan = () => {
        if (isProcessing) return;
        
        const category = ITEM_CATEGORIES[selectedCategory];
        Alert.alert(
            `Scan ${category.name}?`,
            `This will add ${category.points} points to your account.`,
            [
                { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },
                { text: 'Confirm Scan', onPress: () => processScan('manual-scan') },
            ]
        );
    };

    const toggleCategorySelector = () => {
        setShowCategorySelector(!showCategorySelector);
    };

    const selectCategory = (categoryKey) => {
        setSelectedCategory(categoryKey);
        setShowCategorySelector(false);
        resetScanner();
    };

    if (hasPermission === null) {
        return (
            <SafeAreaView style={styles.loadingContainer}>
                <LinearGradient colors={['#059669', '#047857']} style={styles.gradient}>
                    <ActivityIndicator size="large" color="white" />
                    <Text style={styles.loadingText}>Requesting camera permission...</Text>
                </LinearGradient>
            </SafeAreaView>
        );
    }

    if (hasPermission === false) {
        return (
            <SafeAreaView style={styles.permissionContainer}>
                <LinearGradient colors={['#ef4444', '#dc2626']} style={styles.gradient}>
                    <View style={styles.permissionContent}>
                        <Ionicons name="camera-off" size={64} color="white" />
                        <Text style={styles.permissionTitle}>Camera Permission Required</Text>
                        <Text style={styles.permissionText}>
                            Please enable camera access to scan recyclable items and earn points.
                        </Text>
                        <TouchableOpacity style={styles.permissionButton} onPress={getCameraPermissions} activeOpacity={0.8}>
                            <LinearGradient
                                colors={['rgba(255,255,255,0.3)', 'rgba(255,255,255,0.2)']}
                                style={styles.permissionButtonGradient}
                            >
                                <Text style={styles.permissionButtonText}>Enable Camera</Text>
                            </LinearGradient>
                        </TouchableOpacity>
                    </View>
                </LinearGradient>
            </SafeAreaView>
        );
    }

    const currentCategory = ITEM_CATEGORIES[selectedCategory];

    return (
        <SafeAreaView style={styles.container}>
            <StatusBar barStyle="light-content" backgroundColor="#000" />
            
            {/* FIXED: Proper camera container */}
            <View style={styles.cameraContainer}>
                <Camera
                    style={styles.camera}
                    type={CameraType.back}
                    onBarCodeScanned={scanned ? undefined : handleBarCodeScanned}
                    // Remove barCodeScannerSettings since it's not needed with Camera component
                />

                {/* FIXED: Properly layered overlay */}
                <View style={styles.overlay} pointerEvents="box-none">
                    {/* Top section - FIXED positioning */}
                    <View style={styles.topSection}>
                        <Animated.View 
                            style={[
                                styles.headerContainer,
                                { 
                                    opacity: fadeAnim,
                                    transform: [{ 
                                        translateY: slideUpAnim.interpolate({
                                            inputRange: [0, 100],
                                            outputRange: [0, -30]
                                        }) 
                                    }]
                                }
                            ]}
                        >
                            <LinearGradient colors={['#059669', '#047857']} style={styles.headerCard}>
                                <TouchableOpacity
                                    style={styles.backButton}
                                    onPress={() => navigation.goBack()}
                                    activeOpacity={0.7}
                                >
                                    <Ionicons name="arrow-back" size={18} color="white" />
                                    <Text style={styles.backButtonText}>Change</Text>
                                </TouchableOpacity>

                                <View style={styles.categoryInfo}>
                                    <Ionicons name={currentCategory.icon} size={20} color="white" />
                                    <Text style={styles.categoryName}>{currentCategory.name}</Text>
                                    <Animated.View style={[styles.pointsBadge, { transform: [{ scale: pulseAnim }] }]}>
                                        <Ionicons name="star" size={14} color="white" />
                                        <Text style={styles.pointsText}>+{currentCategory.points}</Text>
                                    </Animated.View>
                                </View>
                            </LinearGradient>
                        </Animated.View>
                    </View>

                    {/* Center section - FIXED positioning */}
                    <View style={styles.centerSection}>
                        {/* Instruction */}
                        <Animated.View 
                            style={[
                                styles.instructionContainer,
                                { 
                                    opacity: fadeAnim,
                                    transform: [{ scale: pulseAnim }]
                                }
                            ]}
                        >
                            <LinearGradient colors={['rgba(5, 150, 105, 0.9)', 'rgba(4, 120, 87, 0.9)']} style={styles.instructionCard}>
                                <Text style={styles.instructionText}>Point at barcode or QR code</Text>
                            </LinearGradient>
                        </Animated.View>

                        {/* FIXED: Scanning frame - properly centered */}
                        <View style={styles.scanningArea}>
                            <View style={styles.scanFrame}>
                                {/* Corner brackets */}
                                <View style={[styles.corner, styles.topLeft]} />
                                <View style={[styles.corner, styles.topRight]} />
                                <View style={[styles.corner, styles.bottomLeft]} />
                                <View style={[styles.corner, styles.bottomRight]} />
                                
                                {/* Animated scanning line */}
                                <Animated.View
                                    style={[
                                        styles.scanLine,
                                        {
                                            transform: [{ translateY: scanLineTransform }],
                                            opacity: glowOpacity,
                                        },
                                    ]}
                                />
                            </View>
                        </View>
                    </View>

                    {/* Bottom section - FIXED positioning */}
                    <View style={styles.bottomSection}>
                        {/* Info text */}
                        <Animated.View 
                            style={[
                                styles.infoContainer,
                                { opacity: fadeAnim }
                            ]}
                        >
                            <Ionicons name="bulb" size={14} color="#fbbf24" />
                            <Text style={styles.infoText}>Works with any barcode or QR code</Text>
                        </Animated.View>

                        {/* FIXED: Action buttons - properly spaced */}
                        <Animated.View 
                            style={[
                                styles.actionButtonsContainer,
                                { 
                                    opacity: fadeAnim,
                                    transform: [{ translateY: slideUpAnim }]
                                }
                            ]}
                        >
                            {/* Close/Category button */}
                            <TouchableOpacity
                                style={styles.closeButton}
                                onPress={() => navigation.goBack()}
                                activeOpacity={0.7}
                            >
                                <LinearGradient
                                    colors={['rgba(0,0,0,0.8)', 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)']}
                                    style={styles.closeButtonGradient}
                                >
                                    <Ionicons name="close" size={24} color="white" />
                                </LinearGradient>
                            </TouchableOpacity>

                            {/* Manual scan button */}
                            <TouchableOpacity
                                style={styles.manualScanButton}
                                onPress={manualScan}
                                disabled={isProcessing}
                                activeOpacity={0.8}
                            >
                                <LinearGradient colors={['#059669', '#047857']} style={styles.manualScanGradient}>
                                    {isProcessing ? (
                                        <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="white" />
                                    ) : (
                                        <Text style={styles.manualScanText}>
                                            Scanning: {currentCategory.name}
                                        </Text>
                                    )}
                                </LinearGradient>
                            </TouchableOpacity>
                        </Animated.View>
                    </View>

                    {/* Processing overlay */}
                    {isProcessing && (
                        <View style={styles.processingOverlay}>
                            <LinearGradient colors={['rgba(5, 150, 105, 0.95)', 'rgba(4, 120, 87, 0.95)']} style={styles.processingContent}>
                                <Animated.View style={{ transform: [{ scale: pulseAnim }] }}>
                                    <ActivityIndicator size="large" color="white" />
                                </Animated.View>
                                <Text style={styles.processingText}>Processing scan...</Text>
                                ```
                                <Text style={styles.processingSubtext}>Calculating eco-points</Text>
                                ```
                            </LinearGradient>
                        </View>
                    )}
                </View>
            </View>
        </SafeAreaView>
    );
}
```

## **Fix 4: Alternative ScannerScreen.js** (Without barcode scanner if installation fails)

```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import {
    View,
    StyleSheet,
    SafeAreaView,
    Alert,
    TouchableOpacity,
    Dimensions,
    Animated,
    StatusBar,
    Platform,
} from 'react-native';
import { Text, ActivityIndicator } from 'react-native-paper';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { LinearGradient } from 'expo-linear-gradient';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { recordScan } from '../services/database';
import { useOffline } from '../context/OfflineContext';

const { width, height } = Dimensions.get('window');

// Item categories with your consistent colors
const ITEM_CATEGORIES = {
    'glass-bottles': { name: 'Glass Bottles', icon: 'wine', points: 10, color: '#059669' },
    'plastic-bottles': { name: 'Plastic Bottles', icon: 'water', points: 8, color: '#3b82f6' },
    'aluminum-cans': { name: 'Aluminum Cans', icon: 'cafe', points: 12, color: '#f59e0b' },
    'paper': { name: 'Paper', icon: 'document', points: 5, color: '#8b5cf6' },
    'cardboard': { name: 'Cardboard', icon: 'albums', points: 6, color: '#8b5cf6' },
    'electronic': { name: 'Electronics', icon: 'phone-portrait', points: 25, color: '#ef4444' },
    'organic': { name: 'Organic Waste', icon: 'leaf', points: 15, color: '#22c55e' },
};

export default function ScannerScreen({ navigation }) {
    const { user } = useAuth();
    const { queueOfflineAction } = useOffline();
    
    const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);
    const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState('glass-bottles');
    const [showCategorySelector, setShowCategorySelector] = useState(false);
    
    // Animations
    const fadeAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
    const slideUpAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(100)).current;
    const scanLineAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;
    const pulseAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(1)).current;
    const glowAnim = useRef(new Animated.Value(0)).current;

    useEffect(() => {
        // Entrance animations
        Animated.parallel([
            Animated.timing(fadeAnim, {
                toValue: 1,
                duration: 600,
                useNativeDriver: true,
            }),
            Animated.timing(slideUpAnim, {
                toValue: 0,
                duration: 800,
                useNativeDriver: true,
            }),
        ]).start();

        // Scanning line animation
        Animated.loop(
            Animated.sequence([
                Animated.timing(scanLineAnim, {
                    toValue: 1,
                    duration: 2000,
                    useNativeDriver: true,
                }),
                Animated.timing(scanLineAnim, {
                    toValue: 0,
                    duration: 100,
                    useNativeDriver: true,
                }),
            ])
        ).start();

        // Pulse animation
        Animated.loop(
            Animated.sequence([
                Animated.timing(pulseAnim, {
                    toValue: 1.05,
                    duration: 1500,
                    useNativeDriver: true,
                }),
                Animated.timing(pulseAnim, {
                    toValue: 1,
                    duration: 1500,
                    useNativeDriver: true,
                }),
            ])
        ).start();

        // Glow effect
        Animated.loop(
            Animated.sequence([
                Animated.timing(glowAnim, {
                    toValue: 1,
                    duration: 2000,
                    useNativeDriver: true,
                }),
                Animated.timing(glowAnim, {
                    toValue: 0,
                    duration: 2000,
                    useNativeDriver: true,
                }),
            ])
        ).start();
    }, []);

    const scanLineTransform = scanLineAnim.interpolate({
        inputRange: [0, 1],
        outputRange: [0, 200],
    });

    const glowOpacity = glowAnim.interpolate({
        inputRange: [0, 1],
        outputRange: [0.3, 0.7],
    });

    const processScan = async (scannedData = 'manual-scan') => {
        try {
            setIsProcessing(true);
            
            await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 500));
            
            const category = ITEM_CATEGORIES[selectedCategory];
            const scanData = {
                userId: user.uid,
                itemType: selectedCategory,
                points: category.points,
                timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
                scannedCode: scannedData,
            };

            const result = await recordScan(scanData);

            if (result.success) {
                showSuccessAnimation();
                Alert.alert(
                    'Success! 🎉', 
                    `+${category.points} points for ${category.name}!`,
                    [{ text: 'Scan Another', onPress: () => setIsProcessing(false) }]
                );
            } else {
                if (result.offline) {
                    queueOfflineAction('scan', scanData);
                    Alert.alert(
                        'Queued for Sync 📱', 
                        'Scan saved offline and will sync when connected',
                        [{ text: 'Continue', onPress: () => setIsProcessing(false) }]
                    );
                } else {
                    Alert.alert('Error', result.error || 'Failed to record scan');
                    setIsProcessing(false);
                }
            }
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Scan processing error:', error);
            Alert.alert('Error', 'Failed to process scan');
            setIsProcessing(false);
        }
    };

    const showSuccessAnimation = () => {
        Animated.sequence([
            Animated.timing(pulseAnim, {
                toValue: 1.2,
                duration: 200,
                useNativeDriver: true,
            }),
            Animated.timing(pulseAnim, {
                toValue: 1,
                duration: 300,
                useNativeDriver: true,
            }),
        ]).start();
    };

    const manualScan = () => {
        if (isProcessing) return;
        
        const category = ITEM_CATEGORIES[selectedCategory];
        Alert.alert(
            `Scan ${category.name}?`,
            `This will add ${category.points} points to your account.`,
            [
                { text: 'Cancel', style: 'cancel' },
                { text: 'Confirm Scan', onPress: () => processScan() },
            ]
        );
    };

    const selectCategory = (categoryKey) => {
        setSelectedCategory(categoryKey);
        setShowCategorySelector(false);
    };

    const currentCategory = ITEM_CATEGORIES[selectedCategory];

    return (
        <SafeAreaView style={styles.container}>
            <StatusBar barStyle="light-content" backgroundColor="#000" />
            
            {/* Mock camera background with scanner UI */}
            <LinearGradient colors={['#000000', '#1a1a1a', '#000000']} style={styles.mockCameraBackground}>
                {/* Scanner UI Overlay */}
                <View style={styles.overlay} pointerEvents="box-none">
                    {/* Top section */}
                    <View style={styles.topSection}>
                        <Animated.View 
                            style={[
                                styles.headerContainer,
                                { 
                                    opacity: fadeAnim,
                                    transform: [{ translateY: slideUpAnim.interpolate({
                                        inputRange: [0, 100],
                                        outputRange: [0, -30]
                                    }) }]
                                }
                            ]}
                        >
                            <LinearGradient colors={['#059669', '#047857']} style={styles.headerCard}>
                                <TouchableOpacity
                                    style={styles.backButton}
                                    onPress={() => navigation.goBack()}
                                    activeOpacity={0.7}
                                >
                                    <Ionicons name="arrow-back" size={18} color="white" />
                                    <Text style={styles.backButtonText}>Change</Text>
                                </TouchableOpacity>

                                <View style={styles.categoryInfo}>
                                    <Ionicons name={currentCategory.icon} size={20} color="white" />
                                    <Text style={styles.categoryName}>{currentCategory.name}</Text>
                                    <Animated.View style={[styles.pointsBadge, { transform: [{ scale: pulseAnim }] }]}>
                                        <Ionicons name="star" size={14} color="white" />
                                        <Text style={styles.pointsText}>+{currentCategory.points}</Text>
                                    </Animated.View>
                                </View>
                            </LinearGradient>
                        </Animated.View>
                    </View>

                    {/* Center section */}
                    <View style={styles.centerSection}>
                        <Animated.View 
                            style={[
                                styles.instructionContainer,
                                { 
                                    opacity: fadeAnim,
                                    transform: [{ scale: pulseAnim }]
                                }
                            ]}
                        >
                            <LinearGradient colors={['rgba(5, 150, 105, 0.9)', 'rgba(4, 120, 87, 0.9)']} style={styles.instructionCard}>
                                <Text style={styles.instructionText}>Point at barcode or QR code</Text>
                            </LinearGradient>
                        </Animated.View>

                        <View style={styles.scanningArea}>
                            <View style={styles.scanFrame}>
                                <View style={[styles.corner, styles.topLeft]} />
                                <View style={[styles.corner, styles.topRight]} />
                                <View style={[styles.corner, styles.bottomLeft]} />
                                <View style={[styles.corner, styles.bottomRight]} />
                                
                                <Animated.View
                                    style={[
                                        styles.scanLine,
                                        {
                                            transform: [{ translateY: scanLineTransform }],
                                            opacity: glowOpacity,
                                        },
                                    ]}
                                />
                            </View>
                        </View>
                    </View>

                    {/* Bottom section */}
                    <View style={styles.bottomSection}>
                        <Animated.View 
                            style={[
                                styles.infoContainer,
                                { opacity: fadeAnim }
                            ]}
                        >
                            <Ionicons name="bulb" size={14} color="#fbbf24" />
                            <Text style={styles.infoText}>Works with any barcode or QR code</Text>
                        </Animated.View>

                        <Animated.View 
                            style={[
                                styles.actionButtonsContainer,
                                { 
                                    opacity: fadeAnim,
                                    transform: [{ translateY: slideUpAnim }]
                                }
                            ]}
                        >
                            <TouchableOpacity
                                style={styles.closeButton}
                                onPress={() => navigation.goBack()}
                                activeOpacity={0.7}
                            >
                                <LinearGradient
                                    colors={['rgba(0,0,0,0.8)', 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)']}
                                    style={styles.closeButtonGradient}
                                >
                                    <Ionicons name="close" size={24} color="white" />
                                </LinearGradient>
                            </TouchableOpacity>

                            <TouchableOpacity
                                style={styles.manualScanButton}
                                onPress={manualScan}
                                disabled={isProcessing}
                                activeOpacity={0.8}
                            >
                                <LinearGradient colors={['#059669', '#047857']} style={styles.manualScanGradient}>
                                    {isProcessing ? (
                                        <ActivityIndicator size="small" color="white" />
                                    ) : (
                                        <Text style={styles.manualScanText}>
                                            Scanning: {currentCategory.name}
                                        </Text>
                                    )}
                                </LinearGradient>
                            </TouchableOpacity>
                        </Animated.View>
                    </View>

                    {/* Processing overlay */}
                    {isProcessing && (
                        <View style={styles.processingOverlay}>
                            <LinearGradient colors={['rgba(5, 150, 105, 0.95)', 'rgba(4, 120, 87, 0.95)']} style={styles.processingContent}>
                                <Animated.View style={{ transform: [{ scale: pulseAnim }] }}>
                                    <ActivityIndicator size="large" color="white" />
                                </Animated.View>
                                <Text style={styles.processingText}>Processing scan...</Text>
                                ```
                                <Text style={styles.processingSubtext}>Calculating eco-points</Text>
                                ```
                            </LinearGradient>
                        </View>
                    )}
                </View>
            </LinearGradient>
        </SafeAreaView>
    );
}

// Add this to your existing styles:
const styles = StyleSheet.create({
    // ... existing styles ...
    mockCameraBackground: {
        flex: 1,
    },
    // ... rest of your styles ...
});
```


## **Step-by-Step Fix Instructions:**

1. **Install dependencies:**
```bash
npx expo install expo-barcode-scanner expo-notifications expo-camera
```

2. **Update app.json** to fix splash screen error (use the code above)
3. **Restart your development server:**
```bash
npx expo start --clear
```

4. **If barcode scanner still doesn't work**, use the alternative ScannerScreen.js without barcode functionality (just manual scanning)

The main fixes:

- **Barcode Scanner**: Install `expo-barcode-scanner`
- **Splash Screen**: Update app.json to use existing adaptive-icon.png instead of missing splash.png
- **Layout**: Fixed overlapping elements with proper z-index and positioning
- **Colors**: Consistent with your app's theme (`#059669`, `#f59e0b`)

Try installing the dependencies first, then restart the app!
